faq.title: Answers to popular questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you wanted to know about studying at our school

items.question: What if my child does not like it?
items.answer: The first lesson is free. If your child does not want to continue after it, you pay nothing. We create comfortable conditions for learning.

items.question: Can I change the teacher?
items.answer: Yes, at any time. We will find another teacher who suits your child better. It is free.

items.question: What equipment is needed?
items.answer: A computer, laptop or tablet with a camera and microphone, and a stable internet connection. We will set up Google Meet together during the trial lesson.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: The whole subscription is paid before lessons begin. We accept Visa/Mastercard, Kaspi and bank transfer.

items.question: Can I freeze my subscription?
items.answer: Yes, for up to 2 weeks per subscription period — for illness or holidays. Just let us know 2 days in advance.

items.question: What if we miss a lesson?
items.answer: Tell us 24 hours in advance and we will reschedule without any loss. If we are not notified, the lesson counts as held.

results.title: Real stories of our students
results.subtitle: Here is how kids' lives change after studying with us

cases.title: Case #1: How Alisher turned from a “silent one” into a confident contest participant in one year
cases.story:
Alisher came to us in grade 10 with a classic problem — he knows the grammar but cannot speak. He writes well on tests, but as soon as he has to say something aloud — silence. He was simply afraid of making a mistake and looking silly in front of classmates.

We did not load him with new rules — he already had plenty. We just started talking. About what he is interested in, games, films, everyday situations. After a few months Alisher began answering in lessons on his own, without fear. And a year later he took part in school English contests. Calmly and confidently.
cases.testimonial: "I want to say a huge thank you: after your lessons my son has improved significantly in English and Kazakh, and it is much easier for him to write tests, for which he gets good marks. The teacher presents information clearly and in simple language, is very responsible and punctual, thanks to the extra knowledge studying has become much easier, and my son studies with interest and enthusiasm in the lessons. Thank you so much ❤️"
cases.conclusion: The main thing that changed — Alisher stopped being afraid of the language. He did not become a top student in a month and did not learn 10,000 words. He simply started to speak. And that gave results in everything else.

cases.title: Medina's story: when English stopped being torture
cases.story:
Medina came to us in grade 10 saying: "I no longer believe I can learn English. I just don't have the gift".

Before that she had tried several centres. The same everywhere: the group is rushed through the programme whether you understood or not. One time today, another tomorrow, a third the day after. A mess in the head, nothing sticks. Tears and a feeling that something is wrong with her.

We decided to do it differently. We dropped the standard programme. We started from zero, but immediately began building sentences and talking. No cramming long lists of rules. If a topic is not absorbed, we do not move on. Not until it is clear.
cases.conclusion: Medina did not become an English champion in six months. But she stopped being afraid of it. And for her that is a huge result.

cases.title: Alina's story: from zero to IELTS in two years
cases.story:
Alina came to us in grade 11. English almost from scratch, a jumble of rule fragments in her head, words would not stick, she was shy to speak. And the hardest part — the feeling that it was already too late, that time was lost and nothing could be done.

We started simple. We did not try to catch up on the whole school programme in a month. We just went step by step, at her pace.

Two years have passed. Now Alina writes IELTS essays and describes graphs without even thinking much. In the UNT English exam she shows results she never dreamed of.
cases.testimonial: "I want to thank you and leave a review for the work and the path you have been walking with us, with Alina, for several years now! Asylzhan, thank you so very much for the knowledge, patience, interesting lessons and presentation of material, and the individual approach to English! Special thanks for the support and IELTS preparation — you can't imagine how important your support is and how it adds confidence to Alina! Thanks to you, Alina, practically from "0" knowledge, is now heading to confident command of languages! Alina really likes your lessons, the method and the comfortable, positive atmosphere that motivates her to keep moving forward!"
cases.conclusion: Two years ago Alina thought she was too late. Now she is preparing for IELTS. Simply because we went at her pace and supported her when she herself did not believe in the result.
